item.title: CVE-2026-112066 · 7.1 HIGH — Missing Authorization in extension "sgalinski Cookie Consent" (sg_cookie_optin)
item.description: The JSON import of the cookie consent configuration did not respect the backend user's permissions. Non-admin backend users with access to the module could import a configuration that adds arbitrary scripts to the frontend of the website.

item.description: The backend module does not check whether a backend user has access to the requested site. Users with access to the module can therefore open the analytics dashboard of any site.
